sen0754_init.message0: initialize ultrasonic liquid level sensor %1 serial %2 RX pin %3 TX pin %4
sen0754_init.tooltip: Initialize the SEN0754 ultrasonic liquid level sensor (UART Modbus, fixed 115200 baud). The RX pin connects to the sensor's green TX wire; the TX pin connects to the sensor's blue RX wire. For ESP32-series boards.

sen0754_set_install_height.message0: set install height of %1 to %2 mm
sen0754_set_install_height.tooltip: Set the sensor's top mounting height in millimeters. Water level = install height − empty distance. Default 2000 mm.

sen0754_read_realtime.tooltip: Send the Modbus command to read realtime distance and temperature. Fast response (about 100 ms), for calm liquid surfaces. Read results with the water level / distance / temperature blocks.

sen0754_read_processed.tooltip: Send the Modbus command to read the algorithm-filtered distance and temperature. Stable but slow (≥2 s), for wavy liquid surfaces. Read results with the water level / distance / temperature blocks.

sen0754_get_water_level.tooltip: Returns water level = install height − empty distance (mm). Run a read block first. An empty distance of -3 mm means no liquid detected.

sen0754_get_distance.tooltip: Returns the empty distance (sensor to liquid surface) from the last read, in millimeters. -3 mm means no liquid detected.

sen0754_get_temperature.tooltip: Returns the temperature from the last read (0.1 °C resolution).

sen0754_is_valid.tooltip: Whether the last read (realtime or processed) received a CRC-valid frame; useful for timeout handling.
